svg.title: Two small visual calls
svg.text: Both are drawn in the screens one way; these show the alternative so you can pick.
1A. The ⋯ menu on the title line
Where every other record page keeps it (task, deal, property, contractor). The bar holds only the next step.
1B. The ⋯ menu in the bottom bar
As the spec and screen 03 drew it: beside Approve, so it never moves between stages.
The same word in the same spot as on Your invoices: Received, Approved, Paid with its date.
As screen 06 drew it: Received, Approved, Paid as dots, filled when reached.
1A follows docs/components.md (RecordMoreMenu, the ghost ⋯ on the title's first line); one place for ⋯ across the app.
2A matches screen 07 and the plain-words rule for stages; 2B adds a second way to show the same thing.
